The older man appears surprised and immediately reaches out to shake the younger man's hand. (3) They stand by the dugout railing engaging in a conversation. The older man gestures with his hands frequently, sometimes pointing or patting the younger man's arm. The younger man stands with his back to the camera, listening. (4) The older man continues his animated speech, smiling and occasionally touching the younger man's chest or shoulder in a friendly manner. Media personnel in the background continue to film the interaction. (5) The two men lean across the railing for a warm, long embrace. The older man pats the younger man's back firmly. After the hug, they share a final laugh and the older man claps his hands as the younger man begins to step away.
